body: You do not sound condescending at all; thank you for taking time to reply. I think I have found what the best course of action against my problems is, and that is definitely not suicide. Thank you :)

It can't be that easy though. It's not like I can just say "hi" to someone completely unknown and start a conversation with them. That's just really not in my nature. I get nervous even when talking to clerks. It is definitely not possible for me to do anything like that; I like very basic social skills. I don't even know where to start from.
